note: FROZEN, hand-picked list. This is deliberately NOT a live top-50 ranking: a dynamic universe would silently change which assets are tracked, which makes the training set non-reproducible. Change it only by an explicit commit, and record why in data_sources.md. The JOIN KEY IS cmc_id -- never the symbol string (see XAUt/XAUT, RNDR->RENDER, MATIC->POL). binance_symbol_aliases carries the SAME asset's earlier Binance ticker: backfill that ignores it silently loses those months.

assets.name: Bitcoin
assets.rationale: Market beta. Every other series in the set is measured against it; without it no correlation feature has a reference.

assets.name: Ethereum
assets.rationale: Second beta factor and the settlement layer for most tokens here, so it carries idiosyncratic gas/L2 news on top of market beta.

assets.name: BNB
assets.rationale: Exchange-native beta. It reacts to flow on the very venue we stream from, which makes venue stress observable.

assets.name: XRP
assets.rationale: Large cap that decouples from BTC on legal and regulatory news - a regime the model must not confuse with market moves.

assets.name: Solana
assets.rationale: High-beta large cap: the amplified version of the BTC move. Pairs with BTC to give the model a beta spread.

assets.name: TRON
assets.rationale: Large cap with unusually low realised volatility for its size - a slow large cap against SOL's fast one.

assets.name: Dogecoin
assets.rationale: The liquid meme: large-cap depth with meme-grade volatility. Bridges the anchor and meme cohorts.

assets.name: Cardano
assets.rationale: Large cap on a slow news cycle and low on-chain throughput; long stretches of near-random walk.

assets.name: Tether USDt
assets.rationale: Volatility floor and the numeraire itself. CMC-only by construction: USDT is Binance's quote asset, so USDTUSDT cannot exist.

assets.name: USDC
assets.rationale: The STREAMED negative control. USDCUSDT is a real pair pinned near 1.0: if the model emits signals on this series, the model is broken.

assets.name: Dai
assets.rationale: Over-collateralised peg - it breaks differently from a fiat-backed one. CMC-only: no live Binance USDT pair.

assets.name: First Digital USD
assets.rationale: Venue-native stablecoin. Its depegs are a direct read on Binance-specific stress rather than on the wider market.

assets.name: PAX Gold
assets.rationale: Gold, streamed. A non-crypto risk factor inside the crypto tape - near-zero correlation to BTC by design.

assets.name: Tether Gold
assets.rationale: Second gold token. The PAXG/XAUt spread isolates issuer credit risk from the gold price itself.

assets.name: Avalanche
assets.rationale: EVM-compatible L1 with a subnet story; trades as a mid-cap beta amplifier.

assets.name: Polkadot
assets.rationale: Parachain L1 whose supply schedule and unlocks drive moves independent of price momentum.

assets.name: NEAR Protocol
assets.rationale: L1 repositioned around AI narratives - sits between the L1 and AI cohorts, which is exactly the ambiguity worth training on.

assets.name: Aptos
assets.rationale: Move-VM L1 with a large scheduled-unlock overhang: a clean example of supply-driven drawdown.

assets.name: Sui
assets.rationale: The other Move-VM L1. APT/SUI is a near-matched pair, so divergence between them is signal rather than beta.

assets.name: Cosmos
assets.rationale: Interoperability hub with a long history and a mature, low-momentum tape.

assets.name: Algorand
assets.rationale: Long-lived PoS L1 in structural decline - the model needs assets with negative drift, not only survivors.

assets.name: Hedera
assets.rationale: Enterprise/DAG L1 that moves on institutional announcements rather than on retail flow.

assets.name: Internet Computer
assets.rationale: Post-hype L1 with an extreme boom-bust history; heavy tails the Gaussian assumptions will fail on.

assets.name: Celestia
assets.rationale: Modular data-availability L1: a young asset with a short history, which tests how the features behave near series start.

assets.name: Polygon (prev. MATIC)
assets.rationale: Ethereum scaling token that survived a ticker AND id migration (MATIC to POL) - the reason the join key is the CMC id.

assets.name: Arbitrum
assets.rationale: Optimistic rollup governance token; moves with L2 activity and with airdrop/unlock events.

assets.name: Optimism
assets.rationale: The other optimistic rollup. ARB/OP is a matched pair like APT/SUI, isolating protocol news from sector beta.

assets.name: Litecoin
assets.rationale: The original BTC beta clone with 13 years of history and a halving cycle of its own.

assets.name: Bitcoin Cash
assets.rationale: BTC fork that shares its hash algorithm; correlation to BTC is structural, not behavioural.

assets.name: Stellar
assets.rationale: Payments network that trades partly on XRP news - a cross-asset dependency worth learning.

assets.name: Ethereum Classic
assets.rationale: The ETH fork left on PoW; the ETH/ETC spread separates the chain from the asset.

assets.name: Zcash
assets.rationale: Privacy PoW coin with violent narrative-driven repricings. High-kurtosis training material.

assets.name: Monero
assets.rationale: Deliberate CMC-only asset: delisted from Binance in Feb 2024. It proves the pipeline degrades to one source instead of failing.

assets.name: Chainlink
assets.rationale: Oracle infrastructure; revenue-like usage growth rather than pure speculation.

assets.name: Uniswap
assets.rationale: DEX governance blue chip. Its volume is the on-chain mirror of the CEX volume we stream.

assets.name: Aave
assets.rationale: Lending blue chip; liquidation cascades make it lead the market on the way down.

assets.name: Curve DAO Token
assets.rationale: Stableswap DEX with heavy emissions - persistent negative drift from token issuance.

assets.name: Lido DAO
assets.rationale: Liquid staking governance; a levered bet on ETH staking flows rather than on ETH price.

assets.name: Ondo
assets.rationale: Real-world-asset protocol. Trades on rate and regulatory news that has no crypto-native equivalent.

assets.name: Ethena
assets.rationale: Synthetic-dollar protocol whose token is a levered bet on funding rates - a derivatives-driven regime.

assets.name: Bittensor
assets.rationale: Decentralised ML network; the flagship AI-narrative asset and a very high-priced unit (feature scaling test).

assets.name: Render
assets.rationale: GPU rendering network that also survived a ticker rename (RNDR to RENDER) with its CMC id intact.

assets.name: Artificial Superintelligence Alliance
assets.rationale: AI token formed by a token merger - its history contains a structural break the model must tolerate.

assets.name: Worldcoin
assets.rationale: Identity/AI token with an aggressive unlock schedule; supply shock dominates demand.

assets.name: Shiba Inu
assets.rationale: The original ERC-20 meme: enormous supply, sub-cent price, and a tick size that quantises returns.

assets.name: Pepe
assets.rationale: Pure reflexive meme on Ethereum with no cash flow story at all - the control for 'price is the only signal'.

assets.name: Bonk
assets.rationale: Solana meme: it moves with SOL activity, so it is a meme WITH a beta, unlike PEPE.

assets.name: Pudgy Penguins
assets.rationale: NFT-collectible meme - the same volatility class driven by a different community cycle.

assets.name: Hyperliquid
assets.rationale: Top-10 asset by market cap with NO Binance spot pair. Included precisely so the set contains a large asset the stream cannot see.

assets.name: Kaspa
assets.rationale: Mineable DAG L1 with real market cap and no Binance listing. Second CMC-only asset, from a different behavioural class.
